title: Izinkanyezi Eziyishumi Nanye Ezakhothama
intro: Umuntu ovela eQuran wanikezwa umbono ojulile ebuntwaneni - iphupho lezidalwa zasezulwini zikhothama ngenhlonipho. Iminyaka yayizodlula ngokukhashelwa, ukuhlukaniswa, ukumangalelwa ngamanga, kanye nokuboshwa ngaphambi kokuba lo mbono ugcwaliseke. Ubani lo mphefumulo oqinile onendaba ethatha isahluko eside kunazo zonke seQuran?
clues: Ngake ngaba semncane, ngibusiswe ngephupho elimangalisayo ngisho nobaba wami angixwayisa ukuthi ngiligcine liyimfihlo.
Abafowethu, bephuphuthekiswe umona, bangiceba ugobe bangiphonsa emthonjeni ojulile nomnyama.
Ngathwalwa ngayiswa ezweni elikude futhi ngathengiswa endlini yesikhulu esihloniphekile, lapho ngathola khona umusa futhi ngaphakama ngaba nomthwalo wemfanelo.
Ukumangalelwa ngamanga kwaholela ekuboshweni kwami ​​​​okungenabulungisa, kodwa kuleyo ndawo emnyama ngathola induduzo ngomthandazo nangokukhothamela u-Allah.
U-Allah wangibusisa ngekhono elingavamile lokuhumusha amaphupho, okwagcina kungilethe phambi kombusi wezwe futhi kwangiphakamisa ngaze ngaba ngumuntu othembekile.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokuhlukana, ngaphinde ngahlangana nomndeni wami engiwuthandayo, futhi iphupho lami lobuntwana lezinkanyezi eziyishumi nanye, ilanga, nenyanga kungikhothamela ekugcineni lagcwaliseka.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
